items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Attachment component system. Full API and feature parity with shadcn/ui Base Attachment specification: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/attachment ANATOMY: AttachmentGroup └── Attachment ├── AttachmentMedia ├── AttachmentContent │   ├── AttachmentTitle │   └── AttachmentDescription ├── AttachmentActions │   └── AttachmentAction └── AttachmentTrigger FEATURES & CAPABILITIES: - Full compound composition with subcomponents for flexible media, layout, and metadata display. - Upload lifecycle states: 'idle' | 'uploading' | 'processing' | 'error' | 'done'. - Layout orientations: 'horizontal' (compact row/chip) and 'vertical' (stacked card). - Component sizes: 'default' | 'sm' | 'xs'. - Media variants: 'default' (file-type icons or container wash) and 'image' (aspect-square thumbnails). - Stretched interactive overlay (AttachmentTrigger) with isolated action button stacking (AttachmentActions). - Horizontally scrollable, snapping container (AttachmentGroup) with smooth edge fades. - Base UI polymorphic useRender support across all subcomponents. - Strict compliance with DESIGN.md high-contrast tokens, WCAG AA, and floating focus rings.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Autocomplete primitive (@base-ui/react/autocomplete).

taxonomy: Use Autocomplete for freeform text search inputs with dynamic completion suggestions where the user can either select a suggestion or type their own custom query.
For selecting one or more values from a closed set where selections submit explicit item keys, use Combobox or Select instead.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, flush selection indicator, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar primitive (@base-ui/react/avatar).

taxonomy: Displays a user's profile picture, initials, or fallback icon.
Supports image loading states (idle, loading, loaded, error) and delayed fallback rendering to prevent visual flashes during fast network loads.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant touch targets, and sentence case typography.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge primitive. Aligned with shadcn/ui and Base UI ecosystem patterns: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/badge

taxonomy: Use Badge for PASSIVE, non-interactive status indicators, counts, categories, or labels.
Do NOT use Badge for interactive filters, toggles, or removable tags (use Chip instead).
Implements DESIGN.md High-Contrast Accessible standards:
Pattern 1 (filled): Solid brand fill + high-contrast on-color text.
Pattern 2 (outline): 1px border in color role + neutral white surface fill + colored text.
Pattern 3 (soft): Soft container wash (bg-*-container) + dark neutral charcoal text (on-*-container).
Never uses the banned triple-tint monochrome pattern (light tint + same-hue border + same-hue text).
Full WCAG 2.2 AA contrast compliance.
Polymorphic composition powered by Base UI's `useRender` hook.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: ButtonGroup primitive. Base UI Integration: Pure design token & Base UI companion primitive. Specification & Reference: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/button-group

taxonomy: A container to group related buttons, segmented actions, and inputs with fused borders and shared geometry.
Resolves double-border artifacts (-space-x-px / -space-y-px) while ensuring focus rings stay visible with proper stacking context (focus-visible:z-20).
Fuses concentric border radii: rounds outer corners while flattening adjacent internal edges.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 touch target compliance.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button primitive (@base-ui/react/button).

taxonomy: Use Button for triggering immediate page/dialog actions, form submits, or opening popups.
Do NOT use Button for on/off toggles with persistent state (use Toggle instead).
Do NOT use Button for in-page panel navigation (use Tabs instead).
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius (rounded 8px / 0.5rem), floating 2px focus ring, active micro-motion scaling, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets.
Never uses Sunny Amber (tertiary) text on light surfaces without dark container background.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar primitive (React DayPicker). Base UI Ecosystem Documentation: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/calendar React DayPicker Documentation: https://daypicker.dev

taxonomy: Use Calendar for date, multiple date, and date range selections.
Integrates with React DayPicker v9/v10 while maintaining complete shadcn/ui API compatibility.
Commonly paired with Popover and Button to form a DatePicker.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Lexend body/cell font (font-sans), Atkinson Hyperlegible Next headings, primary brand selection, surface-container range fills, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain Of Thought

items.name: checkbox

Supports parent-child tree checkboxes via the `parent` prop.

Balanced horizontal divider with neutral surface wash.
Accessible 44x44px touch target on the Restore trigger.
Monospace tabular-nums for turn numbering and timestamps.
Single-ring floating 2px focus indicator.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Chip primitive. Built on Base UI (@base-ui/react) interaction foundations.

taxonomy: Use Chip for INTERACTIVE compact elements: 1. Filter chips: Toggleable selection filters with keyboard navigation (aria-pressed). 2. Input/Removable chips: Dismissible tags with accessible remove buttons (onRemove). 3. Action chips: Clickable compact triggers (onClick).
For PASSIVE, non-interactive status labels or counts, use Badge instead.
Implements DESIGN.md High-Contrast Accessible standards:
Pattern 1 (filled): Solid brand fill + high-contrast text.
Pattern 2 (outline): 1px border in color role + neutral white surface fill + colored text.
Pattern 3 (soft): Soft container wash (bg-*-container) + dark neutral charcoal text (on-*-container).
Full WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance (expands to 44px when interactive or removable).
Floating 2px focus ring (outline-offset: 2px) on keyboard focus.

items.name: combobox

Supports multi-selection with inline chips (Combobox.Chips, Combobox.Chip, Combobox.ChipRemove).

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: Confirmation primitive. Base UI Integration: Consumes Base UI Button primitive and Icon primitive.

taxonomy: Dual-purpose component: 1. AI Tool Approval Gate: Conforms to shadcn AI Elements confirmation lifecycle (approval-requested -> approved / denied) for Human-in-the-Loop tool execution. 2. Clinical Decision Gate: Structured inline consent, prescription verification, order sign-off, or risk acknowledgment card in clinical workflows and dashboards.
Conforms to shadcn AI Elements Confirmation specification and DESIGN.md:
High-contrast visual structure with calm clinical amber/neutral tokens.
Clear distinction between pending, approved, and denied states.
WCAG 2.2 compliant 44x44px touch targets on decision buttons.
Floating 2px focus rings (`outline-offset: 2px`).
Concentric radius hierarchy (`rounded-xl` container with `rounded` buttons).

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty primitive. Base UI Integration: Pure design token & Base UI companion primitive. Specification & Reference: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/empty

taxonomy: Use Empty to display empty states when collections, search results, or tables have no items.
Composable compound architecture:
Empty (Root container)
EmptyHeader (Group wrapper for media, title, and description)
EmptyMedia (Icon / Avatar / Graphic tile with variant="default" | "icon")
EmptyTitle (Headline typography in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next)
EmptyDescription (Body typography in Lexend with accessible link styling)
EmptyContent (Actions and button container)
Also supports monolithic convenience props (icon, title, description, action) for backward compatibility.
Follows DESIGN.md: concentric border radius, semantic high-contrast colors, and text-balance / text-pretty.

items.name: error-shake
items.title: Error Shake
items.description: ErrorShake Horizontal form micro-shake wrapper based on transitions.dev (12-error-state-shake.md). Platform Reference: https://transitions.dev/detail.html?t=error-state-shake Shakes invalid form inputs or blocked actions using a decaying overshoot curve: 0% -> 20% (-6px) -> 40% (+4px) -> 60% (-2px) -> 80% (+1px) -> 100% (0) Synchronized with the 300ms animate-error-shake keyframe in src/globals.css. Supports coordinated error message reveals and auto-revert timers. Complies with WCAG 2.2 and motion-reduce:animate-none.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Field primitive (@base-ui/react/field).

taxonomy: Use Field to group a form control with its label, description, and error message.
Supports automatic validation (onSubmit, onBlur, onChange), validation debouncing, and accessibility attribute wiring (id, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-invalid).
Supports vertical (default) and horizontal layouts (for Switch, Checkbox, Radio).
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Fieldset primitive (@base-ui/react/fieldset).

taxonomy: Use Fieldset to group related form controls with a shared legend and description.
Cascades disabled state natively to all nested interactive form controls.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance.

items.title: Form

items.name: inline-alert
items.title: Inline Alert
items.description: InlineAlert primitive. Aligned with shadcn/ui and Base UI ecosystem patterns: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/alert

taxonomy: Use InlineAlert for high-visibility system event or validation banners (neutral, warning, error, success).
Implements a mathematically straight 4px vertical accent bar, ambient elevation, and accessible live regions.
Supports both monolithic props (title, action, onClose) and compound subcomponents (InlineAlert.Title, InlineAlert.Description, InlineAlert.Action, InlineAlert.Close).
Distinct from ClinicianTip (which is low-prominence instructional micro-guidance) and AlertDialog (modal interrupt).
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next headings (font-heading), Lexend body (font-sans), and semantic color roles.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline Citation
items.description: Inline Citation primitive. Base UI Integration: Built on Base UI PreviewCard (@base-ui/react/preview-card), Button (UnstyledButton), and Carousel primitives. Conforms to shadcn AI Elements specification: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/ai-elements/base/inline-citation

taxonomy: Use InlineCitation to embed source references, RAG grounding passages, and web search literature directly inside prose or assistant messages.
Conforms to DESIGN.md:
Pattern 2 high-contrast citation pill (neutral surface fill, outline-secondary border, Rich Emerald text).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch target on interactive triggers.
Floating 2px focus ring with 2px offset (outline-primary).
Single-source preview or multi-source Carousel with tabular navigation.
Full keyboard accessibility and prefers-reduced-motion safety.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: InputGroup primitive. Full API reference and feature parity with shadcn/ui Base Input Group specification: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/input-group ANATOMY: InputGroup ├── InputGroupInput (or InputGroupTextarea) └── InputGroupAddon (align="inline-start" | "inline-end" | "block-start" | "block-end") ├── InputGroupButton └── InputGroupText

taxonomy: Use InputGroup to attach icons, buttons, text prefixes, suffixes, and action toolbars to input fields and textareas.
Bridges single-line search/URL fields and multi-line AI chat prompt inputs under a single visual boundary.
Eliminates double-border and double-focus ring artifacts by delegating focus exclusively to InputGroup.
Integrates seamlessly with Base UI Field (<Field.Control>) for accessible label and error wiring.
Supports polymorphic composition via Base UI's `useRender` hook across all sub-components.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Input primitive (@base-ui/react/input). shadcn Base Input Documentation: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/input ANATOMY: Input (or BaseInput / InputPrimitive)

taxonomy: A native input element that automatically works with Base UI Field context (<Field.Root>).
Implements Modern Web Guidance (MWG: html) tri-token contract for autocomplete, inputMode, enterKeyHint.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls:
0.5rem corner radius (rounded-lg) matching Buttons as the primary form control.

Flush 2px focus indicator with negative 1px offset (focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-primary) for WCAG 2.4.13 contrast and Windows High Contrast Mode (forced-colors: active) compatibility.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant hit target sizes: sm (44px), md (48px), lg (56px).
For complex input layouts with toolbars, prefixes, suffixes, or multiple buttons, compose with <InputGroup> (@/components/ui/input-group).

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Item layout primitive (Content Row / Media Object). Full API reference and feature parity with shadcn/ui Base Item specification: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/item ANATOMY: ItemGroup └── Item ├── ItemHeader ├── ItemMedia ├── ItemContent │   ├── ItemTitle │   └── ItemDescription ├── ItemActions ├── ItemFooter └── ItemSeparator

taxonomy: Use Item and ItemGroup for structured list rows, activity feeds, patient directories, notification trays, and settings rows.
Composes [Media] + [Content (Title, Description)] + [Actions] without custom flex boilerplate.
Directly eliminates the "Card inside Card" anti-pattern by providing a clean, non-elevated content row for lists inside cards and dialogs.
Supports polymorphic composition via Base UI's `useRender` hook across ALL subcomponents.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Lexend body/description font, Lexend label headers, floating 2px focus ring, and strict semantic tokens with zero artificial elevation on list rows.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key primitive (Kbd). Aligned with shadcn/ui and Base UI ecosystem patterns: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/kbd

taxonomy: Use Kbd to visually represent keyboard keys, hotkeys, and shortcut combinations (e.g. ⌘K, Ctrl+B).
Use KbdGroup to compose multiple keycaps together without line breaks.
Ideal for embedding in buttons, command palettes, menus, and tooltips.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Roboto Mono font (font-mono), surface-container wash, subtle outline-variant border, and strict semantic tokens.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu

items.name: menubar

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: MessageScroller primitive suite. Base UI Integration: Consumes Base UI Button and Tooltip primitives. Specification & Reference: - https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/ai-elements/base/chat - https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/message-scroller

taxonomy: The foundational viewport engine for conversational AI interfaces, live transcripts, and clinical chat.
Handles smart auto-scrolling: follows incoming streamed tokens when the user is at the live edge, without hijacking the scroll position if the clinician scrolled up to review clinical history.
Turn Anchoring (`scrollAnchor`): Pins new prompt turns near the top with `scrollPreviousItemPeek` visible.
Jump-to-Latest Control: Smooth floating button to return to the live response edge with unread indicators.
Preserves scroll position on historical message prepends (`preserveScrollOnPrepend`).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant: 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive triggers.
Strictly follows DESIGN.md tokens: floating 2px focus ring, semantic colors, zero triple-tints.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu

items.name: notification-badge
items.title: Notification Badge
items.description: NotificationBadge Isolated diagonal slide-in and scale-pop badge based on transitions.dev (03-notification-badge.md). Platform Reference: https://transitions.dev/detail.html?t=notification-badge Anchors absolutely onto trigger elements (e.g. action buttons, navigation icons) without displacing trigger layout or causing parent jitter. Adheres to Pattern 1 (High-contrast solid fill) with WCAG AAA foreground contrast. Automatically disables motion under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: NumberField primitive (@base-ui/react/number-field).

taxonomy: Use NumberField for numerical inputs with step buttons, keyboard scrubbing, wheel scrubbing, and localized formatting.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets, and motion restraint.

items.name: number-pop-in
items.title: Number Pop In
items.description: NumberPopIn Digit pop-in animation primitive based strictly on transitions.dev (02-number-pop-in.md). Platform Reference: https://transitions.dev/detail.html?t=number-pop-in Decomposes numeric strings into individual character spans. When updated, each digit pops into place with 8px vertical travel, 2px micro-blur, and spring overshoot (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.45, 0.64, 1)). Trailing decimal digits stagger by 70ms so updates feel alive without looking chaotic. Tabular numerals prevent layout jitter. Complies with WCAG 2.2 and motion-reduce:animate-none.

items.name: number-roll
items.title: Number Roll
items.description: NumberRoll Tabular number transition primitive based strictly on transitions.dev. Platform Reference: https://transitions.dev/library.html Supports: - 'pop-in' (default): Individual digit pop-in with spring overshoot and decimal stagger (02-number-pop-in.md). - 'spinning': Slot-machine vertical reel roll with soft edge masks (26-spinning-counter.md). Exports both all-in-one <DataTable /> and composable subcomponents: DataTableColumnHeader, DataTablePagination, DataTableViewOptions, DataTableFacetedFilter, DataTableToolbar, DataTableRowActions, createSelectColumn, createActionsColumn.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questionnaire composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives and design tokens: - `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Input` (`src/components/ui/input.tsx`) - `Progress` (`src/components/ui/progress.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`) - `Kbd` (`src/components/ui/kbd.tsx`)

taxonomy: Multi-step guided question primitive and flow engine for intake forms, assessments, onboarding sequences, configuration wizards, and conversational agent clarification prompts.

Follows the shadcn/ui Questionnaire part structure and API: Root, Progress, Item, Title, Description, Choices, Choice, ChoiceInput, ChoiceLabel, ChoiceShortcut, Input, Error, Actions, Previous, Skip, Next, and Submit. Items take `multiple` (the legacy `type="multiple"` still works) and answers serialize to FormData with one repeated entry per selected value (`FormData.getAll(name)`). Choices are role-based rather than native radio/checkbox inputs.

Supports single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform text entry, keyboard shortcuts (A-Z, 1-9), roving tabindex arrow key navigation, form validation, draft restoration, and native FormData serialization.

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (min-h-11 touch targets), floating 2px focus indicators, fieldset/legend semantics, inert inactive items, live error regions, and container-query responsiveness (@container).

items.name: step-wizard
items.title: Step Wizard
items.description: StepWizard composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives and design tokens: - `Button`, `UnstyledButton` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`)

taxonomy: Controlled multi-step workflow container for guided intake, onboarding, assessment flows, and multi-stage form sequences.
Pure UI: receives step data via props, manages directional slide transitions, and emits progression intents via callbacks (`onStepChange`, `onComplete`).

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (44x44px minimum touch targets on all interactive step markers and buttons), floating 2px focus indicators (`outline-offset: 2px`), and live regions (`aria-live="polite"`).
Modern HTML integration: supports `hiddenUntilFound` with `hidden="until-found"` and `beforematch` event listener so browser search (<kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd>) finds inactive step content.
